companyName: British American Tobacco Bangladesh Company Limited
title: Board approved investment for purchasing & installing laser jet printer
content: The company has informed that the Board of Directors of the company in its meeting dated 24th February 2025 approved the investment of BDT 24.90 crore for purchasing & installing laser jet printer in 36 SMD packing lines in both Dhaka & Savar factory. The investment will be funded from internal sources and bank financing based on the cash flow of the Company. The details are as follows: Printer cost: BDT 14.55 crore, Printer installation cost: BDT 10.35 crore and Total Estimated Cost: BDT 24.90 crore.

companyName: British American Tobacco Bangladesh Company Limited
title: Clarification on recent news published in newspaper
content:
In response to a DSE query letter to the company regarding a news published in a newspaper titled "BATB may face legal action over labour law violations" on March 16, 2025, in response the company has informed DSE, among others, the following: "As a responsible company, British American Tobacco Bangladesh (BATB) is committed to full compliance with the local laws and regulations. (cont.)

(Cont. news of BATBC): We have noted all the regulatory observations by DIFE and are engaging with the relevant authorities as appropriate. We have outlined the measures we have undertaken as well as those currently in progress and have engaged with DIFE on these matters. BATB strictly adheres to all applicable laws and ensures that all employees receive the benefits they are entitled to under the country's legal framework."  (end)

companyName: British American Tobacco Bangladesh Company Limited
title: Q1 Financials
content:
(Q1 Un-audited): EPS was Tk. 5.89 for January-March 2025 as against Tk. 7.65 for January-March 2024; NOCFPS was Tk. (17.62) for January-March 2025 as against Tk. (10.49) for January-March 2024. NAV per share was Tk. 97.77 as on March 31, 2025 and Tk. 106.88 as on December 31, 2024. (cont.)

companyName: British American Tobacco Bangladesh Company Limited
title: Regarding investment in Savar factory to increase the current capacity
content: The Board of Directors of the company in its meeting dated 25th June 2025 approved the investment of BDT 297 Crore (equivalent to approximately GBP 20 million) to increase the current capacity of its Savar factory in response to its Dhaka factory closure. The investment will be funded from internal sources and bank financing based on the cash flow of the Company.

content:
